What's new in 1.2.3

  • Accessibility no longer reports itself as granted when it isn't. Setup asked macOS twice: once properly, and once by trying to read the frontmost app — in the belief that this only works with the permission. It also works without it when Cueshot itself is in front, which is exactly the case while the setup window is open. So the row went green, nothing had been granted, and dictation kept landing on the clipboard. One question now, asked the same way everywhere.
  • If you flip the switch for Accessibility or Input Monitoring while Cueshot is running, setup says right there that it only reaches a freshly started Cueshot, and offers the restart.
